content.intro: Production systems delivered for real client and operational use.

cases.title: LG Energy Solution — Talent Data Automation
cases.description: Replaced manual candidate data collection by building an AI-driven system that navigates complex websites, extracts structured data, and delivers consistent outputs for internal operations. Tech: Crawl4AI, LangGraph, FastAPI, Python.

cases.title: AI-powered Legal & Tax Document Search
cases.description: Reduced time-intensive legal document search for a tax professional client by building an AI system that understands queries, retrieves relevant materials, and filters results before delivery. Search time was reduced from up to 5 hours to under 40 minutes, with search accuracy improved by over 50%. Tech: LangChain, Ollama, ChromaDB, FastAPI, Docker.

cases.title: Scenera (TnM AI) — Enterprise AI Systems
cases.description: Delivered multiple AI systems for enterprise clients across data access, IoT pipelines, video analytics, predictive maintenance, and edge deployment. These systems reduced manual operations, improved operational efficiency, and supported production use across media, manufacturing, and retail environments. Tech: Python, FastAPI, Docker, LangChain, SQL, Azure.

cases.title: 2asy.ai — Automated AI Content Platform
cases.description: Built and operate a fully automated AI system that collects, summarizes, translates, and publishes economic news. The system runs 13 times daily with zero manual intervention and operates at roughly 5–10% of the cost of typical cloud-based alternatives. Tech: LangGraph, vLLM, Docker, FastAPI, Python.
